errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the line style for the EU series as a 'black line with two dots'. The legend and the chart show this series is represented by a long dashed line ('- -').

The description incorrectly identifies the line style for the Japan series as a 'black solid line'. The legend and the chart show this series is represented by a dash-dot line ('- .'). The black solid line represents Bulgaria.

errors.text_span: За линията на ЕС: Тя започва около 22% през 2000 г. и завършва около 24% през 2018 г., като показва леко увеличение.
errors.evidence: The description confuses the data for the EU with the data for Japan. The EU line starts at 5% and ends around 6%. The values described (22% to 24%) correspond to the Japan line.

errors.text_span: За линията на САЩ: Тя започва около 15% през 2000 г.
errors.evidence: The starting value for the USA is described as 'around 15%', but the chart shows it starting significantly lower, at approximately 13%.

errors.text_span: За линията на Япония: Тя започва около 5% през 2000 г. и завършва малко над 5% през 2018 г., като показва лека промяна.
errors.evidence: The description confuses the data for Japan with the data for the EU. The Japan line starts at approximately 22.5% and ends around 25%. The values described (around 5%) correspond to the EU line.

errors.text_span: За линията на България: Тя започва малко под 4% през 2000 г.
